title: Live-Action Blue Lock Film Confirms 3 More Cast Members
content: The staff for the live-action film based on Muneyuki Kaneshiro and Yūsuke Nomura 's BLUE LOCK soccer manga confirmed three more cast members on Monday. The film's staff also announced that the film will screen in MX4D, 4DX, and Dolby Cinema starting on August 21.
author: ANN

title: Cat Companions Maruru and Hachi Manga Returns From Hiatus
content: Sonoda put the manga on hiatus in January 2025 due to health reasons. Seven Seas Entertainment publishes the manga in English, and it describes the story: An odd couple of stray cats team up to share the trials and tribulations of life in this heartwarming manga.
author: ANN

title: Twin Engine, Bandai Form Strategic Partnership to Co-Create New IPs
content: Animation production and planning company Twin Engine and Bandai have entered a strategic partnership aimed at jointly creating and developing new intellectual properties (IPs), with the two companies planning to invest up to 4 billion yen (approximately US$25.25 million) in manga development and animation production.
author: MyAnimeList

title: 'With Vengeance, Sincerely, Your Broken Saintess' Season 2 Streams 2nd Teaser
content: The official website for the second light anime season based on SORAJIMA and Aminohada 's With Vengeance, Sincerely, Your Broken Saintess ( Kizu Darake Seijo Yori Hōfuku wo Komete ) vertical-scrolling webtoon started streaming the anime's second teaser promotional video on Monday.
author: ANN

title: Sefure, Nana & Kaoru Manga Creator Ryuta Amazume Reveals Cancer Diagnosis
content: Manga creator Ryuta Amazume announced on August 6 that they have been diagnosed with cancer. Amazume stated that they will undergo treatment and aim for a complete recovery. Amazume added that they will be going a hiatus from commercial manga serialization for a while.

title: Convenient Semi-Friend Manga's Finale Slated for September 9
content: Houbunsha announced on Friday that Minori Chigusa 's Convenient Semi-Friend manga will reach its "grand finale" in the October issue of Houbunsha 's Manga Time Kirara magazine on September 9.
author: ANN

title: Team India Wins Award at World Cosplay Summit 2026
content: Team India won "ZIPAIR's Next Journey Category" at the World Cosplay Summit 2026. Karan Desai cosplayed as Yoshimitsu and Karan Prakash as Devil Jin in the competition being held from July 31 to August 2 at Oasis 21 , Nagoya, Japan.
author: ANN
